# Radoslav Radev Requires Around Five Seconds Of Straddle Planche Before Learning The Straddle Planche Push-Up

Radoslav Radev says that before you start with the straddle planche push-up you need a foundation of around five seconds straddle planche. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 00:16]

## Details

- Before you start the straddle planche push-up, he says you need a foundation of around five seconds straddle planche. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 00:16]
- He says the five second straddle planche does not need to be 100% clean, but there are important mistakes that you have to fix first. [src: vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 00:21]

## Evidence

- vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 00:16 (Radoslav Radev): "So before you start with the straddle planche push-up you need foundation of around five seconds straddle planche"
- vid-8z2Jmgf8GH8 @ 00:21 (Radoslav Radev): "the five second straddle planche you don't need to do it 100% clean but there is important mistakes that you have to fix"
